body.tagline: Y'all come back now, ya hear?
body.overview: Jed Clampett's swamp is loaded with oil. When a wildcatter discovers the huge pool, Jed sells his land to the O.K. Oil Company and at the urging of cousin Pearl, moves his family to a 35-room mansion in Beverly Hills, California.
body.name: The Beverly Hillbillies
